北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天晴，体感 2℃，注意防风保暖，多喝水润燥哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but windy and cold at 2℃. Stay warm, protect from wind, and hydrate!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波阴天，体感 15℃ 舒适。出门逛逛，记得带上好心情！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is cloudy and comfortable at 15℃. Go out and bring your good mood!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 14℃ 挺舒服的，注意适时增减衣物，别着凉啦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, a pleasant 14℃. Dress appropriately and avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 20℃ 温暖舒适，湿度较高，保持好心情哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm at 20℃, with high humidity. Keep a good mood!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 22℃ 偏暖，风力较大。出门注意防晒补水哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm at 22℃, with strong winds. Remember sun protection and hydration!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 11℃ 稍冷，穿暖和点，小心感冒哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and a bit chilly at 11℃. Dress warmly to avoid colds.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 13℃ 略有凉意，别忘了加件外套哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels a bit cool at 13℃. Don't forget a jacket!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 11℃ 湿冷，注意保暖，多喝热饮暖身呀。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and damp-cold at 11℃. Stay warm and enjoy hot drinks.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 11℃ 湿冷，出行注意安全，记得保暖哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and damp-cold at 11℃. Travel safely and stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 6℃ 有些冷，穿厚实点，暖暖和和过一天。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and a bit cold at 6℃. Dress warmly for the day.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 13℃ 湿润。出行注意能见度，保持愉快哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy and humid at 13℃. Watch out for visibility and stay cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴，体感 -7℃ 寒冷且风大，务必穿上最厚的冬装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but very cold and windy at -7℃. Be sure to wear your warmest winter clothes!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴，体感 -1℃ 寒冷有风，多穿点，注意防寒保暖哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but cold and windy at -1℃. Dress warmly to stay protected from the cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴，体感 14℃ 舒适，风力较大，享受阳光但注意防风！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant at 14℃ with strong winds. Enjoy the sun, but mind the wind!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 16℃ 宜人，是个散步的好天气，心情也要美美的。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and pleasant at 16℃. It's a great day for a walk, keep a lovely mood!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 8℃ 寒冷风大。减少户外活动，注意防护保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy and cold/windy at 8℃. Limit outdoor activities and stay warm and protected.
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 5级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 3℃ 寒冷风大。戴好帽子围巾，温暖出行哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, cold and windy at 3℃. Wear a hat and scarf to stay warm when heading out!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云，体感 22℃ 暖和，早晚温差注意，保持愉快哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy and warm at 22℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night, stay cheerful!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 12℃ 略凉，出门记得添件薄外套，保持舒适哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels a bit cool at 12℃. Bring a light jacket to stay comfy.
